title: Use Svelte 5 runes for explicit reactivity
guideline: Use $state/$derived/$effect deliberately rather than relying on implicit reactivity everywhere

title: Scope stores to the feature that owns them
guideline: Avoid one giant global store; colocate stores with the feature/module they belong to

title: Fetch page data in load functions
guideline: Use +page.ts/+page.server.ts load functions instead of fetching in onMount for initial data

title: Use built-in transitions for simple animation
guideline: Reach for Svelte's transition:/animate: directives before pulling in an animation library

title: Key #each blocks with a stable id
guideline: Use {#each items as item (item.id)} for reorderable lists, not bare index-based iteration

title: Use SvelteKit form actions for forms
guideline: Prefer server-side form actions with progressive enhancement over pure client-side fetch submits
